body:
# the contributor audit: complete critical menus do not cover the mixed set

Audited `candidate 0c18dc829db98d22`,
including its strict-no-heavy disk and triangle examples. PASS.

For the three-fiber examples the convex hull has exactly the prescribed
fibers because (A+B)/2=(4/5)T is contained in K=T. The total area is
123/50 and each of 1/4,1,121/100 is strictly less than123/100.

At the middle origin, any nonvertical through-point cap has endpoint
contribution |A|+|Bcap outside(-A)|. This identity uses only reflection
and -A subset B; section boundaries are area-null. The strict inclusion
-A subset int(B) ensures positive Bcap implies strictly positive excess:
the nonempty cap above max(the cap threshold,h_(-A)(u)) is a positive
area subset outside -A. Thus equality forces Bcap of zero area.

For disks the own contribution is exactly1/2 in every direction; for
triangles it is at least4/9, with equality only in the three canonical
vertex directions. The elementary triangle computation covers all
possible signs of the three vertex evaluations. Its values range from
4/9 to1/2 for a single-positive-vertex cap; the complementary case is
at least1/2. Hence the stated complete equality menu is correct.

A containing cap with a strict offset adds positive middle-fiber slab
area relative to its through-origin shift, so no additional offset
minimizer is missed. Pure integer caps have mass at least the whole
middle area1 and cannot minimize. The thresholds -11rho|u|/10 for disks
and -11/15 in barycentric normalization for triangles are correct.

Every noncentral middle point has an ordinary cap strictly smaller than
the central ordinary minimum. A sufficiently negative FINITE integer
tilt makes A full and B empty while keeping that own cap. At either
endpoint a finite exposing tilt isolates every own cap. Endpoint maxima
are strictly below the claimed middle depths3/4 and25/36. This proves
uniqueness of the GLOBAL deepest point, not only fiberwise optimality.

All critical caps miss the interior of B. The disk menu covers its
boundary, while the triangle menu covers exactly its three vertices.
The entire middle fiber is covered by the available directions, and A
is strictly full. Thus the uncovered positive area121/100 is rigorously
certified after accounting for every deepest source and every critical
containing halfspace. Supporting traces are points, hence H_1-null.

The two-fiber and all-n cube versions use the same exact own-cap
isolation argument. Their statements are valid but are not needed for
the stronger strict-no-heavy obstruction. None violates OC; the
conclusion concerns only the failed coverage implication.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
